name: Supabase Free bounded Harz and Innsbruck refresh-safe cores v1
description: A deterministic staging-only capacity profile. It preserves every required evidence class and the Brocken–Schierke–Ilsenburg and Innsbruck–Nordkette anchors inside two explicitly bounded cores, with minimal source-backed category-preservation corridors and room for one retained refresh generation. It is not full Harz or full Innsbruck Alpine Pilot coverage.

baseRegions.coverageLabel: Harz core: Ilsenburg–Brocken–Schierke plus a narrow southern mapped-hut verification corridor
baseRegions.shape: rectangular anchor core with a narrow source-backed wilderness-hut verification corridor
bounded Innsbruck–Nordkette core with a narrow Natterersee category-preservation corridor

limitations: Not full Innsbruck Alpine Pilot coverage
The narrow Harz wilderness-hut and Innsbruck lake corridors preserve source-backed evidence categories but do not imply broad coverage around those corridors
Bad Harzburg and Wernigerode are outside the Harz refresh-safe core
Seefeld in Tirol, Fulpmes and Neustift im Stubaital are outside the Innsbruck refresh-safe core
Requests outside the stored polygons must not be presented as covered
Mapped presence and access tags are not guarantees of current safety, legality, opening or water availability
